 Ted Seides – Interviewing and Manager Meetings (Capital Allocators, EP.94) 
 
 Ted Seides – Interviewing and Manager Meetings (Capital Allocators, EP.94) Apr 8, 2019

 A few months ago, Marcel van de Hoef interviewed me on his
podcast, The Meeting Strategist.  He created Meeting
Strategist to help senior professionals across industries think
more strategically about business conversations and improve their
listening, questioning and meeting skills. 

 With his permission, I’ve shared that discussion on this week’s
show.  You can learn more about his work at meetingstrategist.org .

 Our conversation starts with my background and covers my
communications with Warren Buffett, characteristics of successful
active managers, manager meeting structure, culture assessment,
tools for effective listening, lessons I learned from David
Swensen, and my preparation and conducting of podcast
interviews.

 Please enjoy my thoughts on interviewing and manager meetings,
with Marcel van de Hoef asking the questions.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
